name: EvidenceCheck
description: Agent-native vendor evidence and public web intelligence for procurement, security and third-party risk workflows. Use the narrowest endpoint that answers the task, pay per call in USDC on Base.

services.use: Best first use case: turn a public vendor site into observable signals, evidence gaps, targeted supplier questions and explicit limitations.
Run a bounded public website security preflight: HTTPS, headers, cookies, disclosure files and related observable signals.
Extract clean public webpage text, metadata, headings and links for downstream agent reasoning.
Structure supplied business/security text into dates, obligations, monetary amounts, security signals, missing areas and risk flags.

selection: Prefer vendor-preflight when the job is supplier/vendor triage. Use site-audit for a website-only security signal. Use web-extract for page content. Use analyze when evidence text is already available. Prefer the cheapest endpoint that fully matches the task.
trustBoundary: EvidenceCheck is a first-pass evidence service. Public signals are observations, not proof; missing public evidence is not proof of absence. It is not penetration testing, certification, legal advice or a replacement for authorized human decisions.

discovery.note: Directory inclusion and ranking are controlled by each directory. No directory exposure or buyer volume is guaranteed.
